notes.title: Next Fest Gravity Break Rundown
notes.notes: The Next Fest demo contains an introduction to the core loop and mechanics of Gravity Break. This will introduce the controls and the core loop, as well as look into some of the interesting choices you make underway.

notes.title: Demo Released!
notes.notes:
After a year of work on this demo, I am finally releasing it to the world! There is still so much to do, but I want to let people experience the game where it is right now.

The goal of the demo is to earn as much as possible within 10 minutes of landing on Earth. There is plenty of opportunity to cheat, but without doing anything shady, you should be able to get 100.000 after landing on Earth the first time.

The game contains simple simulations of physics and economy, which interact to create a unique experience, where you drag heavy cheese from the gravity wells of planets.

Please join the Discord, leave a like and review or just go for a highscore :)

notes.title: Pre-alpha closed demo launched!
notes.notes:
